messages:
maya: Quick coordination q — we want to start a gradual rollout for structured-output / function-calling. Planning to gate with two flags: `enable_structured_output_v2` (server-side global) and `sdk_fncall_compat` (client SDK toggle). Draft plan below, pls ack and call out gaps.

sam: +1. Can you paste the exact flag semantics? need to know fallback behavior for older SDKs.

maya: Flag defs: 
- `enable_structured_output_v2` = server toggles new response shape + function-routing metadata.
- `sdk_fncall_compat` = SDK will: if true, transform new structured responses into legacy `text` callbacks (best-effort) and surface `functions` via `onFunction` hook; if false, SDK surfaces raw structured JSON and `function_call` events.

lee: For rollout audiences: internal-only (team + staging) -> 5% beta customers -> 25% opt-in via account flag -> 100%. Suggest staging smoke for 48h, then canary 1h, then 24h at 5%.

natalie: Guardrails: automatic fallback to `text-digest` model if structured parsing errors > 0.5% over 1h or increases latency by > 200ms p50. Also require telemetry tags: `structured_v2=true|false`, `sdk_compat=true|false`, and `canary_bucket=<name>`.

alex: For client SDKs: need a minor semver bump and changelog. Also add opt-out runtime check: SDK should detect `enable_structured_output_v2` header and warn if `sdk_fncall_compat` is mismatched. I'll open a PR for the JS/TS clients. Ping me for review @alex.

maya: thx. Alex — can you include automated tests:
```
// unit: when sdk_fncall_compat=true, incoming structured response -> call onText + onFunction with a wrapper
// e2e: simulated function call with malformed args should cause server fallback metric
```

sam: CI: add a nightly job to run a small set of prompts against the canary model and assert no regression >1% in token error rate. I'll add a `structured-ci` pipeline in YAML.

ci-bot: created pipeline: `structured-ci/nightly` (runs 02:00 UTC). Link: https://ci.internal/redwood/pipelines/structured-ci/nightly

lee: Ops question — what about Dedicated / Private customers? They may not want remote toggles. Propose: `enable_structured_output_v2` default off for Private; expose migration docs and an admin endpoint for customers to flip when ready.

maya: yes. Private customers get an on-prem artifact flagged in release notes. We'll coordinate with solutions eng for opt-in.

natalie: Monitoring: add dashboards: latency p50/p90 for structured responses, function call success rate, parsing error rate, and schema-violation events (tagged with route and model). Also add an alert: schema-violation rate > 0.2% for 15 min -> paging oncall.

sam: minor UX detail — SDK should log a single warning per session if compat is off and server is serving v2, and provide a link in the warning to migration guide. Avoid spamming.

alex: PRs: SDK bump + docs: I'll open PRs for JS, Python, and Go. Tagging reviewers: @maya, @lee, @natalie. Expect drafts by EOD.

maya: rollout checklist (short):
- [ ] server-side flag implemented & tested (feat/struct-server)
- [ ] SDK compat flag impl + unit tests (feat/struct-sdk)
- [ ] CI pipeline + nightly (sam)
- [ ] dashboards + alerts (natalie)
- [ ] canary deploy + 1h smoke (deploy-bot will start)
- [ ] docs + changelog (alex)
- [ ] solutions eng customer comms for Private + Dedicated (maya)

lee: I can take the server-side tests and the canary playbook. Putting an initial checklist in the internal runbook.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: `canary/struct-output-v2` -> starting in 15m for bucket `beta-5pct` :rocket:

maya: Heads-up: when canary starts, please watch `structured-v2/error-rate` and `structured-v2/latency-p50` dashboards. If anything spikes, revert server flag immediately — we have an automatic rollback if error-rate > 0.5% in 10m.

lee: noted. I'll be on watch for the first 2 hours.

sam: quick question on telemetry: do we tag by customer id for opt-in? we should anonymize tokens.

natalie: yes, use `customer_hash` not raw id; store only for 7 days for debugging, then roll off. I'll update the telemetry PR.

alex: if anyone needs a quick demo for docs or sales, I can prepare a 5-slide deck + example repo snippet.

maya: last asks before launch: @alex please link the PRs here when ready. @sam add the ci pipeline link. @natalie add the dashboard links. I'll kick off the canary once PRs are green.

lee: ack.

sam: ack.

alex: will post PRs in thread.

natalie: will post dashboard links.

deploy-bot: canary started: `canary/struct-output-v2` bucket=beta-5pct at 1778800723

maya: :eyes: watching. good luck team — ping here for any immediate rollbacks or odd customer reports.

sam: :thumbsup: ongoing checks running.

alex: PRs: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk-js/pull/912, https://git.internal/redwood/sdk-py/pull/188, https://git.internal/redwood/sdk-go/pull/76

natalie: dashboards: https://metrics.internal/redwood/d/struct/output-v2 and https://metrics.internal/redwood/d/struct/functions

lee: found one small regression in staging where schema-violation logs were missing request-id. pushing fix to feat/struct-server.

maya: thanks. keep this thread for quick pings during the canary, we can spin a follow-up postmortem in `postmortems/` if anything notable happens.

sam: noted — will capture CI runs and attach to the postmortem if needed.

maya: end of thread for now.
